title: AgGrid UX polishing
description: Add color-coding, inline JSON modal viewer, and context menu for tasks; enable bulk operations and filters.
acceptance: Rows colored by done/failed; modal JSON viewer works; bulk actions verified.

title: Modal JSON viewer / inspector
description: Add a modal pane for deep inspection and pretty JSON formatting.
acceptance: Select a task -> click Inspect -> modal opens with pretty JSON.

title: ANN evaluation endpoint & UI job
description: Provide server-side ANN evaluation endpoint to run tools/eval_ann.py as background job.
acceptance: Upload GT set in UI -> background job runs -> result saved to ingest_jobs and Task.

title: Reranker (Cross-encoder)
description: Integrate cross-encoder reranker for final scoring of candidate chunks.
acceptance: Reranker used in pipeline and improves evaluation precision.

title: Async ingestion workers (Redis/Celery)
description: Background ingestion workers with job tracking and retries.
acceptance: Jobs survive restarts and UI polls ingest_jobs for progress.
